This appeal has been filed by the appellant/claimant under Section 173 of Motor Vehicles Act, 1988,
is arising out of award dated 21.01.2021 passed by Additional Member, MACT, District - Dhar (MP),
in Claim Case No.53/2018 on account of inadequacy of compensation and seeking enhancement of compensation.
(2) The date of accident, negligence and the issue of liability is not in dispute, however the finding recorded by the Tribunal in this regard is not in question.

As per the finding of the Tribunal in the case of permanent disability suffered by appellant/claimant - Daru Bhil S/o Shri Gulsingh, the amount of compensation has been allowed accepting earning of Rs.2500/- per month and the total compensation awarded as Rs.1,50,789/-.

(3) Counsel for the appellant taking exception to the award contended that the impugned award passed by the Claims Tribunal was not proper as the appellant could not earn money during the treatment period and has suffered permanent disability in the accident and his future prospects of earning has not been assessed and therefore the Tribunal in all fairness ought to have been awarded the just compensation to the appellant which has not been done in this case.

Besides the expenses incurred on the other hand has not been properly calculated and therefore the impugned award deserves to be set-aside and prays for reasonable amount of compensation may be awarded to him.
(4) Per contra, counsel for the respondent No.6 - Insurance Company contended that Tribunal has rightly awarded the compensation and argued in support of the finding recorded by the Tribunal.

(5) After hearing counsel for the parties and on perusal of the record it appears that the appellant has sustained 12% permanent disability of whole body whereas in the accident his right leg was operated and rod was inserted on it which reveals suffering of 37% permanent disability in leg, PDC.
Ex.P/42 was duly issued by Doctor Shri Devendra Mandloi AW3.
The aforesaid document/exhibit has been verified by the respondent No.6 - Insurance Company and thereafter assessment has been made in respect of compensation.

(6) Thus looking to the certificate issued by the Doctor as regards permanent disability of appellant/claimant, in the considered opinion of this Court, the permanent disability to the extent of 12% of whole body has been taken into consideration and the income of the appellant has been assessed by the Tribunal Rs.4500/- per month with appropriate multiplier of 14 the amount of compensation for permanent disability comes as under:-
Permanent disability : Rs.1,13,400/- (Rs.4500/- + 25% x 12 = 67,500/- x 12% + 8,
100 x 14) Conveyances : Rs.2000/-
 Pain & Suffering: Rs.25,000/-
 Special Diet: Rs.5000/-

______________________________ Enhanced Amount - Rs.50,400/-
______________________________ (7) The amount is enhanced from Rs.1,50,789/- to Rs.2,01,189/- and after reducing the same the total comes to Rs.50,400/- with interest as fixed by the Tribunal over and above the amount already awarded by the Tribunal.
(8) In the result, the appeal is allowed in part and to the extent indicated here-in-above.

The enhanced amount i.e. Rs.50,400/- shall carry interest @ 9% per annum from the date of filing of the claim petition till its realization and the finding in respect of liability awarded by the Tribunal shall remain intact.
